trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ تَبْهَرُ قُدْرَتُهُ الْاَفْكَارَ وَتَمْلَاُ عَجَاۗئِبُهُ الْاَبْصَارَ الَّذِيْ لَا يَنْقُصُهُ الْعَطَاۗءُ وَلَا يَعْتَرِضُ جُوْدَهُ الذَّكَاۗءُ (الذَّكَّاۗءُ) الَّذِيْ اَنْطَقَ الْاَلْسُنَ بِصِفَاتِهٖ وَاقْتَدَرَ بِالْفِعْلِ عَلٰى مَفْعُوْلَاتِهٖ وَاَدْخَلَ فِيْ صَلَاحِهَا الْفَسَادَ وَعَلٰى مُجْتَمَعِهَا الشَّتَاتَ وَعَلٰى مُنْتَظَمِهَا الْاِنْفِصَامَ لِيَدُلَّ الْمُبْصِرِيْنَ (الْمُتَبَصِّرِيْنَ) عَلٰى اَنَّهَا فَانِيَةٌ مِنْ صَنْعَةِ بَاقٍ مَخْلُوْقَةٌ مِنْ اِنْشَاۗءِ خَلْقٍ (خَالِقٍ)۔

lines.rarabic: SUBHAANA MAN TAB-HARO QUDRATO-HUL AF-QAARA WA TAMLA-O A’JAA-E-BOHUL AB-SAARAL LAZEE LAA YAN-QOSO-HUL A’TAA-O WA LAA YA’TAREZO JOODA-HUZ ZAKAA-UL (AZ ZAKKAA-O) LAZEE ANTA-QAL AL-SONA BE-SEFAATE-HI WAQTA-DARA BIL-FE’LE A’LAA MAF-OO’LAATE-HI WA AD-KHALA FEE SALAAHE-HAL FA-SAADA WA A’LAA MUJTAMA-E’HASH SHA-TAATA WA A’LAA MUNTA-ZAME-HAL INFE-SAAMA LE-YADUL-LAL MUBSE-REENA (AL MOTA-BASSE-REENA) A’LAA ANNA-HAA FAANE-YATOON MIN SAN-A’TE BAA-QIN MAKH-LOO-QATOON MIN IN-SHAA-E KHALQE (KHAALE-QE).

trans.en: Glory be to God whose Power is dominant over the thoughts, whose wonders have filled the eyes, His Bestowals do not diminish and smart asking does not force Him to bestow! He Himself who made the tongues to speak about His Attributes, and He was Powerful to do what He did with His Own Acts. And He joined corruption with their correctness, scattering with their union, and discord with their orderliness so as to guide the blind ones that all of them shall be destroyed and they are the created by the Creator.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: لَا بَقَاۗءَ وَلَا دَوَامَ اِلَّا لَهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْغَالِبُ الَّذِيْ لَا يُغْلَبُ وَالْمَالِكُ الَّذِيْ لَا يُمْلَكُ الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ بَلَّغَنِيْكِ (بَلَّغَنِيْ) لَيْلَةً طَوَيْتُ يَوْمَهَا عَلٰى صِيَامٍ وَرُزِقْتُ فِيْهِ الْيَقَظَةَ مِنَ الْمَنَامِ وَقَصَدْتُ رَبَّ الْعِزَّةِ بِالْقِيَامِ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنْهُ تَخُصُّنِيْ وَنِعْمَةٍ اُلْبِسَتْنِيْ وَحُسْنٰى نَعَشَتْنِيْ وَاَسْئَلُهُ اِتْمَامَ ابْتِدَاۗئِهٖ وَزِيَادَةً لِيْ مِنِ اجْتِبَاۗئِهٖ فَاِنَّهُ الْمَلِيْكُ الْقَدِيْرُ وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِهٖ وَسَلَّمَ كَثِيْرًا۔

lines.rarabic: LAA BAQAA-A WA LAA DAWAA-MA ILLAA LAHUL WAAHE-DUL GHAALE-BUL LAZEE LAA YUGH-LABO WAL-MAALE-KUL LAZEE LAA YUMLE-KUL HAMDO LILLAA-HIL LAZEE BALLA-GHANEE-KE (BALLA-GHANEE) LAIY-LATAN TAWEE-TO YAUW-MAHAA A’LAA SEYAA-MIN WA RO-ZIQTO FEE-HIL YAQA-ZATA MINAL MA-NAAME WA QASAD-TO RABBAL I’ZZATE BIL-QEYAAME BE-RAH-MATIN MINHO TA-KHUS-SONEE WA NE’MATIN UL-BESAT-NEE WA HUSNAA NA-A’SHAT-NEE WA AS-ALOHO ITMAA-MAB TEDAA-E-HI WA ZIYAA-DATAN LEE MENIJ TABAA-E-HI FA-INNA-HUL MALEE-KUL QADEERO WA SALLAL LAAHO A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE-HI WA SALLAMA KASEE-RAN.

trans.en: There is no survival or lasting except for Him the Only, the Winner who cannot be defeated. You are the Ruler who cannot be ruled! Praise be to God, Who let me reach this night that I spent its day with fasting. He blessed me with staying up instead of sleeping on it. And with all-night vigil I ask my Lord of Honor to allocate His special mercy to me, bless me with His blessings, and cover me with His kindness. I ask Him to finish the beginning of this night. And He increased the things which He has granted me because He is the Powerful King. God’s many salutations be upon Muhammad (s.a.w.a) and his Progeny (a.s) with plenty of peace.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
